title: Bhediya
description: Bhaskar visits a small town with his cousin for work, but after a wolf attack, his life changes as he gains strange powers and struggles with his new werewolf identity.

title: Bhaag Milkha Bhaag
description: Milkha Singh, the Flying Sikh, battles hardships and pain to rise as a world champion, Olympian, and one of India's most legendary and inspiring athletes.

title: Mohra
description: Roma and Jindal free Vishal from jail. Grateful, he joins them, only to realise he's being used as a pawn in a dangerous game of power.

title: Badrinath Ki Dulhaniya
description: Badrinath wants a traditional wife. Vaidehi wants freedom. They must challenge old ways and find their own path. They will redefine what it means to be together.

title: Kambakkht Ishq
description: Simrita, a doctor, operates on Viraj, whom she dislikes. She accidentally leaves her watch inside his and must fix the mistake before her career and life fall apart.

title: Hera Pheri
description: Vijay and Ajay survive by stealing, but their bond is shaken when Vijay learns that Ajay's father might have killed his own father, igniting conflict and testing their loyalty and friendship.

title: Jeene Do: Let Us Live
description: An ambitious cyclist arrives in Mumbai for a championship final, but his world flips when he uncovers his family's painful past, driving him into a dangerous quest for vengeance.

title: Cinebuzz
description: Celebrity interviews, movie reviews, and the latest Bollywood buzz-Cinebuzz brings you the glam and gossip straight from the heart of Indian cinema.

title: Vardi
description: A fearless police officer takes on a dangerous criminal network, risking his life to uphold justice and protect society from corruption and violence.

title: Dus
description: When terrorist Jamwaal plots destruction in Canada during the Indian Prime Minister's visit, a skilled team of Indian agents is deployed on a dangerous mission to stop his deadly plan.

title: Swades
description: Mohan, an Indian expatriate employed with NASA, travels to his country to track down his beloved nanny, Kaveri. During his stay, he finds himself advocating for reform in a village.

title: Yuva
description: Three Kolkata youths: an idealist leader, a money-minded immigrant aspirant, and a brutal goon become linked after a daylight murder attempt on Hooghly bridge that day.

title: Haseena Maan Jaayegi
description: After a prank angers their father, mischievous brothers Sonu and Monu are sent to Goa for work, where they fall in love and try every trick to win their beloveds' father's approval.

title: Chand Mera Dil - 2026
description: Veera, a carefree man, enters the competitive world of traditional wrestling, where rivalry, romance and determination transform his life.

title: Mahaan
description: A lawyer hides after being falsely accused. His wife gives birth to twins. Years later, fate reunites the family under painful but healing circumstances. Love finds its way back.
